entries.test: a call site inside an already-unreached function is a survivor, not a casualty
entries.symptom: Failed on the Mac, green on CI and in the cloud; recorded as pre-existing in the 2026-09-23 ux-11 and s19 TDD records.
entries.cause: scripts/route-deletion-impact.mjs ran git grep -E '\bname\b'; macOS POSIX regex has no \b, so every symbol had zero call sites there. Fixed with git grep -w -F (plan item 37).
entries.evidence: test/route-deletion-impact.test.js test 9 reproduces it on Linux with a BSD-regex git shim; real-repo report under that shim was 32 falling / 400 unreached before, 2 / 33 after (same as Linux).
